_meta.purpose: Stage 0 of plans/candleserv-repair-rework.md — per-exchange repair tuning + empirically-probed max history depth. tile_size = each adapter's real per-request row clamp. throttle_ms/timeout_ms = stated defaults. *_depth_minutes = minutes back from now the public API actually served, minus a safety buffer.
_meta.host_dependent: Both reachability AND depth depend on where the software is installed. Exchange API availability varies by region / IP band worldwide and is NOT a fixed per-venue property — any venue may be unreachable, rate-limited differently, or serve different history from a given host. These values were probed from the candleserv host's region; venues unreachable from there were probed from another region to capture their depth. Re-probe from the actual deployment host, and treat a runtime-unreachable venue as a fail-loud condition, never a silent drop. kraken's public OHLC REST serving only the most-recent ~720 1m candles is a genuine endpoint limit (not host-dependent).
_meta.flagged_shallow_peg: bybit — candles deep (2020-03-25) but peg shallow (2026-04-16, ~7 weeks): its USDTUSD spot kline has almost no history. A USDT venue with a shallow peg cannot be USD-normalized beyond its peg depth, so omit it from the formula for windows deeper than peg_depth_minutes.

kraken._note: Public OHLC REST serves only the most-recent ~720 1m candles (~12h) regardless of `since`; cannot deep-backfill 1m via this endpoint. 720 is the raw served window (NOT buffered down — buffering to 0 would silently make kraken un-repairable). USD-native (no peg).

okx._note: Earliest BTC-USDT 1m candle 2018-01-11T11:12:00Z; depth minus 1440-min buffer. Probed 2026-06-03 from a different region than the candleserv host, which could not reach this venue at probe time — an instance of region/IP-dependent reachability (see _meta.host_dependent), not a venue-specific trait. tile_size 100 = okx history-candles per-call hard cap (adapter paginates internally). USD-native (no peg).

gate._note: Gate caps 1m history at ~10,000 candles (~7 days) and returns OutOfHistory beyond. Both candle and peg are hard-capped to this window; not a probe failure.

bitget._note: Bitget spot candles endpoint served back only ~30 days (2026-05-03) for both BTC and the USDCUSDT peg from this host. May be an endpoint-side window cap rather than the true listing date; re-probe if deeper bitget history is needed.
